name: System Info (Computer + OS)
description:
This module requires no configuration.

Click RUN to view comprehensive system information including:
- Computer name and domain
- Operating system details and version
- Hardware specifications (CPU, RAM)
- Disk space for all drives
- BIOS/Firmware information
